juce::MidiKeyboardState Class Reference

## Detailed Description

Represents a piano keyboard, keeping track of which keys are currently pressed.

This object can parse a stream of midi events, using them to update its idea of which keys are pressed for each individual midi channel.

When keys go up or down, it can broadcast these events to listener objects.

It also allows key up/down events to be triggered with its [noteOn()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#abf5a03498a4cdb64e2e5b6704268a3ef "Turns a specified note on.") and [noteOff()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#a36995e903f895d5ba0b6cc69d82cdf08 "Turns a specified note off.") methods, and midi messages for these events will be merged into the midi stream that gets processed by [processNextMidiBuffer()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#a0a838c354c34be0efcf5d77cdb111f57 "Scans a midi stream for up/down events and adds its own events to it.").

|  |  | int | _numSamples_, |

Scans a midi stream for up/down events and adds its own events to it.

This will look for any up/down events and use them to update the internal state, synchronously making suitable callbacks to the listeners.

If injectIndirectEvents is true, then midi events to produce the recent [noteOn()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#abf5a03498a4cdb64e2e5b6704268a3ef "Turns a specified note on.") and [noteOff()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#a36995e903f895d5ba0b6cc69d82cdf08 "Turns a specified note off.") calls will be added into the buffer.

Only the section of the buffer whose timestamps are between startSample and (startSample + numSamples) will be affected, and any events added will be placed between these times.

If you're going to use this method, you'll need to keep calling it regularly for it to work satisfactorily.

To process a single midi event at a time, use the [processNextMidiEvent()](https://docs.juce.com/master/classjuce_1_1MidiKeyboardState.html#a483eedc5c4d185436eed23fbede739f8 "Looks at a key-up/down event and uses it to update the state of this object.") method instead.

juce::MidiKeyboardState Class Reference

Detailed Description

Represents a piano keyboard, keeping track of which keys are currently pressed.

This object can parse a stream of midi events, using them to update its idea of which keys are pressed for each individual midi channel.

When keys go up or down, it can broadcast these events to listener objects.

It also allows key up/down events to be triggered with its noteOn() and noteOff() methods, and midi messages for these events will be merged into the midi stream that gets processed by processNextMidiBuffer().
